text:
maria: Kickoff: get Redwood listed across AWS/GCP/Azure. Scope = AMIs/VM images, marketplace product metadata, legal artifacts (EULA, VAT/tax IDs), trial SKUs, packaging (terraform/helm), docs quickstart. Who owns which cloud? :wave:
aj: I'll take AWS AMIs + publisher product setup. Need the IAM publisher role & an S3 bucket for the manifest. ETA EOW.
devon: Legal here 12: I'll need EULA draft, company tax/VAT IDs, supported countries list, and export control questionnaire completed. Also include a LICENSES.txt for OSS deps.
sam: Product: I'll own GCP image build + SKU mapping. Suggest 14-day trial, metered seats config. I'll post SKU naming convention today.
tina: DevEx will produce quickstart, examples, and terraform snippet. Need a sample API key flow and a minimal curl example.
aj: AWS manifest example (minimal) for infra to prep bucket/roles:
```json
{
  "product": "redwood-inference",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "artifacts": {
    "images": {
      "us-east-1": "ami-0abc12345EXAMPLE",
      "eu-west-1": "ami-0def67890EXAMPLE"
    },
    "installers": "s3://redwood-marketplace/installers/1.0.0/"
  },
  "licenses": "LICENSES.txt"
}
```
aj: Also: list of publisher account IDs that should get publisher permissions, and role ARNs for cross-account access.
devon: Add: legal review needs third-party license list, indemnification language, and a short privacy/data handling blurb for the listing. I'll circulate a template.
ops-bot: Reminder: create #marketplace-wip channel and upload manifests before EOD if possible.
maria: Azure: volunteers? We need image validation + Offer/Plans setup.
sam: I can start Azure offer scaffolding but will need infra help to validate marketplace VM images and test ingestion.
aj: I'll coordinate cross-region AMI replication and share account ARNs by EOD tomorrow. Tagging @tina for docs once AMIs are stable.
tina: I'll draft the quickstart repo skeleton and examples using sam's SKU names. Will include terraform snippet and a simple docker run + curl example for local dev.
maria: Action items with deadlines: aj (AWS AMIs, manifest, account ARNs) by 2025-03-12 EOD, sam (GCP images + SKU mapping + Azure staging kickoff) by 2025-03-12 EOD, devon (EULA + export questionnaire + LICENSES.txt checklist) by 2025-03-10, tina (docs skeleton + quickstart + terraform sample) by 2025-03-09. Sync: Tue 9am PT in #partnerships. Ping me for blockers. :calendar: :thumbsup:
